name: Lee Takada
source:
Likes: Coffee

Backstory: Lee is a graphic designer who has trouble making friends. Mostly due to their quiet and reclusive personality, they generally fly under the radar, until they first meet the main character at a music lounge. Lee eventually decides to join the rest of the main cast in their journey to creating a music label as their new graphic designer. After a while they get to know the others and become more open as a person.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sweethersh/heartbeats-relaunch-a-music-filled-visual-novel-dating-sim]Kickstarter[/url]]
